spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,json,os
out=open(os.environ['OUT']+'/tx-records.jsonl','w');dec=json.JSONDecoder()
for line in open('store/jobs/j000021/out/candidate-records.txt'):
 m=re.match(r'(\S+) (\d+) (.*)',line); text=m[3]
 for match in re.finditer(r'\{"currencies":|"!personalNotes!data":',text):
  pos=match.start() if match.group().startswith('{') else match.end()
  try: value,end=dec.raw_decode(text[pos:])
  except: continue
  out.write(json.dumps({'encoding_file':m[1],'physical_offset':int(m[2])+pos,'value':value})+'\n')
out.close()
print(open(os.environ['OUT']+'/tx-records.jsonl').read()[:6000])
PY
